rules.name: Local machine only
rules.statement: A served map is reachable only from the machine that runs the server.
rules.risk: A map opens every line of a project's source, so a reachable server would let strangers read private code.

sites.why: Opens the listening address on this machine alone, so a connection from another machine never arrives.
Refuses a page request whose address names any host other than this machine.
Refuses the same way for a request that changes the remembered project list.

rules.name: Deliberately added projects only
rules.statement: A project folder is served only when it was deliberately added, never because the server found it.
rules.risk: One careless start could otherwise put every repository on the machine in front of the browser.

sites.why: Builds the served set from the remembered folder list alone, with no search of the disk.
Refuses to add a folder that holds no coyodex data folder inside it.
Applies the same check to a folder named when the server is started.
Refuses a change to the remembered list unless the request came from this server's own start page.

rules.name: No path leaves the project
rules.statement: A request for a file can only ever reach inside the mapped project's own folder.
rules.risk: Any page open in the browser could otherwise read private files anywhere on the machine.

sites.why: Rejects a file request whose path is absolute or climbs above the project folder.
Rejects a working copy read that escapes the project or names the version history folder.
Refuses a file whose real location, after following a shortcut, sits outside the project folder.
Hands back a shared page asset only when the requested name is one of the two allowed names.

rules.name: Ignored files stay hidden
rules.statement: A file that version history deliberately ignores is never handed back to the browser.
rules.risk: A local settings file holding passwords is kept out of version history, and would otherwise be readable in the map.

sites.why: Allows a working copy read when version history already tracks the file.
Allows an untracked file only when no ignore rule covers it.

rules.name: Frozen at the map's commit
rules.statement: Code shown beside the map is the version the map was built from, not whatever sits on disk now.
rules.risk: A reader comparing a box against edited code would blame the map for a mismatch the map never made.

sites.why: Answers a file request at the map's own commit unless the address asks for another version.
Builds the file list from version history at the map's commit rather than from the folder on disk.
The instructions tell the reader that data and source both come from history at the map's commit.

rules.name: Plain version names only
rules.statement: A version name arriving in a web address is refused unless it reads as an ordinary commit name.
rules.risk: A crafted name could otherwise be taken as an instruction and make the history reader do something else.

sites.why: Refuses a requested version that is not a plain commit identifier.
Skips the history read entirely when the map's own recorded commit is not plain.
Refuses a version name from a web address that does not read as an ordinary one.

rules.name: Fingerprint-checked outside code
rules.statement: Code fetched from the public internet runs in the viewer only when its fingerprint matches the expected one.
rules.risk: A tampered drawing or highlighting library would run inside a page that already shows every line of the project's source.

sites.why: Pins the expected fingerprint of the picture panning library.
Pins the expected fingerprint of the diagram drawing library.
Pins the expected fingerprint of the styling that colours source code.
Pins the expected fingerprint of the code colouring library itself.

rules.name: Known editors only
rules.statement: A source link may open only through an address belonging to a known code editor.
rules.risk: A hand-typed link pattern could otherwise run script in the page or send the reader somewhere unexpected.

sites.why: Offers no link when the built address is not one a known editor answers.
Refuses to save a hand-typed link pattern whose address is not a known editor one.
